raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that the organization recognizing Vince Phillips’ title was the World Boxing Hall of Fame, conflating the sanctioning body (IBF) with a Hall of Fame and misidentifying the larger recognizing body. This was a premature, unverified assumption and a misidentification; the correct larger Hall of Fame recognizing the IBF is the International Boxing Hall of Fame.
